checks_performed: Labware definition loading and deck slot validity
Basic typing/argument validation for API calls
Robot and labware API usage/constraints validation
notes: Validate by locally simulating the Protocol API v2 script with the official Opentrons CLI. No robot is required. If custom labware is used, include the definitions with: opentrons_simulate -L /path/to/custom_labware generated_code/generated_script.py. The simulation will raise errors for API misuse, missing/invalid labware, and pipette/volume constraints. It does not verify robot calibration or physical execution.
